article.title: Introducciones de artículos académicos coreanos: un estudio comparativo
article.part: Contraste y dominio C2 — 대조와 C2 고급 운용
article.chapter: Norma, estilo y elección avanzada C2 — 규범·문체·C2 고급 선택

claims.summary: Lim (2020) compares introductions of Korean and Japanese academic articles in language studies using a modified CARS model; its claims concern that genre sample.

For the Korean introductions analyzed, the study reports frequent references to research and study objects/prior studies, and repeated presentation of research purpose compared with a single presentation in the Japanese articles in the comparison.

The findings are limited to the sampled language-study article introductions and do not establish universal Korean academic register rules or the article’s removed claims about endings, nominalization, and impersonality.
